Strong understanding of social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube.
Basic knowledge of digital marketing, content creation, and social media analytics.

d: The Specialist, FCC Investigations will support the delivery of Saudi Arabia’s Financial Crime Compliance surveillance and investigations programme. The role covers Transaction Monitoring, Transaction Screening and Name Screening, with a focus on managing risks relating to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions, proliferation financing and fraud.

The role holder will investigate alerts and referrals, assess potentially suspicious activity and determine whether cases should be closed, escalated to the Country Money Laundering Compliance Officer, or reported to the relevant Saudi authorities. They will also support regulatory reporting, governance updates and responses to requests from the Saudi Central Bank and other relevant forums.

This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports. The successful candidate will, however, provide practical guidance to newer analysts and work closely with country, regional and business stakeholders.
q: Around five years’ relevant experience in FCC investigations, transaction surveillance, screening, CDD or related financial crime activities.
Good knowledge of AML, CTF, proliferation financing, sanctions and fraud risks , with strong investigative and analytical skills.
Experience applying FCC policies and regulatory requirements, managing cases and making sound risk-based decisions.
Relevant professional qualification or training, such as ACAMS or FCC Training Academy , would be advantageous.
Working knowledge of Saudi Arabian AML/FCC regulatory requirements is preferred.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
r: Deliver timely and high-quality financial crime investigations, surveillance activities, risk assessments and governance support in Saudi Arabia. The role requires sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to identify, document and escalate financial crime concerns appropriately.
Support implementation of the country FCC strategy and raise material investigation or control concerns through the appropriate channels.
Help stakeholders interpret and apply relevant laws, regulatory expectations, FCC policies and emerging industry practices.
Provide clear and practical guidance on financial crime risk matters to support informed business decisions.
AML, CTF, PF, Sanctions & Fraud Investigations and Core Processes
Maintain a current understanding of internal policies and Saudi Arabian requirements relating to AML, CTF, proliferation financing, sanctions and fraud.
Conduct investigations from initial referral through to closure, escalation or regulatory reporting.
Review alerts within agreed timelines, obtain additional information from relevant business teams and document clear investigation outcomes.
Prepare high-quality case assessments and suspicious activity reports for review by the Country Money Laundering Compliance Officer.
Ensure cases are progressed and concluded within agreed turnaround times.
Support day-to-day Name Screening, Transaction Monitoring and Transaction Screening activities, together with ad hoc investigations.
Maintain complete and accurate records in relevant case-management systems, investigation trackers, watch lists and regulatory reporting logs.
Assess financial crime exposure across customers, transactions, products, segments and geographies.
Identify and escalate unusual or potentially suspicious activity and recommend proportionate risk responses.
Follow through on decisions and actions agreed with the Country Money Laundering Compliance Officer.
Provide relevant updates on financial crime risks, control issues and remediation plans to governance forums.
Support reviews requested by the Country Money Laundering Compliance Officer.
Participate in relevant Saudi Central Bank and industry forums and remain informed of regulatory developments.
Coordinate accurate and timely periodic and ad hoc regulatory submissions.
Recommend improvements that strengthen, simplify or enhance FCC controls.
Support control testing under the Operational Risk Framework and help drive identified remediation actions.
Analyse investigation and surveillance data to identify emerging vulnerabilities and risk trends.
Promote ethical conduct, open communication, risk awareness, inclusive teamwork and effective prioritisation.
Provide on-the-job guidance to new analysts when required.
Demonstrate the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct and support the Bank’s Conduct Principles.
Work collaboratively with Saudi Arabia Business, Operations, CFCR Governance, SSU teams and relevant country, cluster and regional FCC stakeholders.
Undertake other responsibilities assigned under applicable Group, country, business or functional policies and procedures.
Financial crime prevention: A strong interest in protecting the Bank and its clients through careful investigation, balanced judgement and appropriate escalation.
Control improvement: Motivation to identify control gaps, understand root causes and improve detection while maintaining effective governance.
Collaborative delivery: The ability to manage cases promptly while working effectively with country, regional and business stakeholders.
